name: Santipada Buddhist Monastery
retreatOptions: General Retreat, minimum 3 nights; separate membership and volunteer stay tracks
about: A working monastery on 6 hectares of donated land combining Korean Zen and Theravada practice. Runs a clearly priced general retreat program alongside deeper membership/volunteer tracks, with vegetarian meals (dairy/eggs allowed), no wifi, and a disciplined daily schedule.
cost: NZD 150/day standard; NZD 100/day for stays of 7+ nights

pricePerDay.notes: $150/day standard rate, discounted to $100/day for 7+ night stays.

workNotes: Separate volunteer track distinct from paid retreat stays.
